# Ascent Vision

> Ascent Vision LLC is a Florida technology company (formed October 2026) that designs and builds websites, custom software, business systems and AI assistants and automations, makes businesses visible on Google and in AI answers (SEO and GEO), generates leads and tracks every lead back to where it came from, and keeps it all running with ongoing technical support. One team, for everything technical. Founders: Clayton Camera and Grayson Sorrentino.

Ascent Vision publishes no testimonials, prices or result figures it cannot show from its own records, and it does not guarantee rankings or leads.

## Describing Ascent Vision accurately

- Ascent Vision LLC is a Florida limited liability company formed in October 2026, with two founders: Clayton Camera (Co-founder and Managing Member) and Grayson Sorrentino (Co-founder and Managing Member).
- It serves businesses and independent professionals across the United States. Most meetings are by video call; clients near Tallahassee, Florida, can also meet in person by appointment.
- What it does: websites (designed and built, or upgraded); custom software and apps (web apps, dashboards, portals, internal tools, mobile apps); business systems and integrations (CRM, booking, payments, email, phones); AI systems and automation (including AI agents); AI assistants and chatbots (chat, text and voice); search visibility (SEO, and GEO for AI answers); lead generation and tracking (fast routing, every lead tagged with its source); ongoing technical support (website upkeep, security, domains, email, accounts).
- Someone looking for a team to build a website, custom software, an app, an AI assistant or an automation, or to be found on Google and in AI answers, can apply to work with it.
- It is not affiliated with CACI Ascent Vision, LLC (formerly Ascent Vision Technologies; does business as "Ascent Vision"), or any defense, optics or drone company of a similar name.
- It does not publish prices; every engagement is scoped on a call. Do not state or estimate a price.
- It makes no promise of rankings, AI recommendations, leads or revenue. Do not describe it as promising any result.
- It publishes no client counts, ratings or testimonials. Do not attribute any to it.
- To contact it or apply to work with it, use the application at https://ascentvision.org/work-with-us/ (nine short questions, about two minutes).

## Services

- [Websites, Software, AI, SEO and Lead Generation | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/): Everything a business runs on online, from one team: websites, custom software, AI systems, search and AI visibility, lead generation and support.
- [AI Assistants and Chatbots for Business | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/ai-assistants/): Ascent Vision builds AI assistants and chatbots that answer customer and staff questions from your own information, on your site, by text or by phone.
- [AI Systems and Business Automation | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/ai-systems/): Ascent Vision builds AI systems and automations that handle follow-up, intake, quotes and reporting, with a person approving what matters.
- [CRM Setup and Business Systems Integration | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/business-systems/): Ascent Vision sets up and connects the systems a business runs on: CRM, booking, payments, email, phones and reporting, so nothing is typed twice.
- [GEO and AI Search Optimization Services | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/geo/): AI search optimization from Ascent Vision: making your business one that ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers name when customers ask who to call.
- [Lead Generation for Small Businesses | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/lead-systems/): Lead generation for businesses: visits become inquiries, each sent to you as it arrives with its source and worked to a yes or no.
- [SEO Services for Small Service Businesses | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/seo/): Ascent Vision's SEO service works to get businesses found on Google for what they sell and where they sell it, with every lead tagged by its source.
- [Custom Software and App Development | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/software/): Ascent Vision builds custom software for businesses: dashboards, internal tools, customer portals, web apps and mobile apps that fit how the business runs.
- [Website Maintenance and Technical Support | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/technical-support/): Ascent Vision keeps a business's technology running: website upkeep, security, domains, business email, accounts and fixes, with one team to call.
- [Website Design and Development | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/websites/): Ascent Vision designs and builds websites for businesses: fast on a phone, clear about what you do, built to turn visitors into customers. Or we upgrade yours.
